lines.trans: Vika, did something happen to you? You look pale.
Eleonora said that we need to make an edible menu.
And I have no idea at all how to make it.
If you want, let me make it? I have seen one before.
Thank you, Lavrov, but I will figure everything out myself.
Vika, stop showing your proud temper already!
I told you clearly that I will make it myself!
Fine! Then this evening the edible menu must be ready!
That is great, you are always welcome, Victoria Sergeyevna!
And while you are at it, clean this whole kitchen spotless!

заодно.gloss: at the same time, while I'm at it

meanings.en: at the same time, while one is at it
meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'одно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'брать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to remove, to take away; to tidy up', paired with 'убирать'.
